bead.title: ADR: change-log Kafka interface provider and shape (heimq vs fjord)
bead.description: Product requirement (2026-07-05): the change log needs a Kafka-protocol consumer interface, provided by heimq or possibly fjord. TD-008 'Delivery interfaces' records two admissible shapes: (a) pqueue-as-broker — pqueue-server embeds a Kafka read surface (Metadata/Fetch/consumer groups over heimq-wire) serving change topics from the committed log tail; (b) external broker — the emission task produces into a heimq/fjord deployment which owns consumer groups/offsets/fan-out. This ADR must settle: provider + shape; offset↦CommandPosition mapping (epoch-aware, never regresses across failover); consumer-group/offset ownership; retention alignment with the log/snapshot frontier; CL-8 tenant authz on the Kafka surface; reconciliation note vs ADR-005 (data-plane-only scope, already added).
bead.acceptance: New ADR accepted and stamped in the ddx graph; TD-008 'Open decisions' entry resolved and TD-008 updated to normative; provider/shape decision recorded with the offset mapping, offset ownership, retention frontier, and authz sections present; ddx doc stale clean after re-stamp.
